FROM Employee E
WHERE Salary > (
    SELECT AVG(Salary)
    FROM Employee
    WHERE Department = E.Department
);

problems.title: Connect Two PCs in Cisco Packet Tracer
problems.description: Create a simple network by connecting two PCs using a Copper Cross-Over cable in Cisco Packet Tracer.
problems.code:
Steps:
1. Open Cisco Packet Tracer.
2. Drag two PCs onto the workspace.
3. Select Copper Cross-Over Cable.
4. Connect FastEthernet0 of PC0 to FastEthernet0 of PC1.
5. Assign IP Addresses:
   PC0 : 192.168.1.1
   PC1 : 192.168.1.2
6. Verify connectivity using Ping.
problems.output: Both PCs communicate successfully using the ping command.

4. Configure:
   PC0 : 192.168.10.1
   PC1 : 192.168.10.2
   Subnet Mask : 255.255.255.0
5. Test using Ping.
problems.output: Ping is successful and both PCs are connected through the switch.

problems.title: Configure Router
problems.description: Configure a router interface with an IP address using Cisco IOS commands.
problems.code:
Router> enable
Router# configure terminal
Router(config)# interface gigabitEthernet0/0
Router(config-if)# ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
Router(config-if)# no shutdown
Router(config-if)# exit
Router(config)# exit
Router# write
problems.output: Router interface is configured and activated successfully.

problems.description: Configure a router as a DHCP server to automatically assign IP addresses.
problems.code:
Router(config)# ip dhcp pool LAB
Router(dhcp-config)# network 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
Router(dhcp-config)# default-router 192.168.1.1
Router(dhcp-config)# dns-server 8.8.8.8
Router(dhcp-config)# exit
problems.output: Clients automatically receive IP addresses from the DHCP server.

problems.title: Configure DNS Server
problems.description: Configure a DNS server in Cisco Packet Tracer to resolve domain names.
problems.code:
Steps:
1. Add a Server.
2. Assign IP Address : 192.168.1.100
3. Services → DNS → ON
4. Add Record:
   Name : www.college.com
   Address : 192.168.1.50
5. Configure clients to use DNS Server 192.168.1.100.
problems.output: Clients can access www.college.com using its domain name.

problems.title: Router-to-Router Connection
problems.description: Connect two routers in Cisco Packet Tracer and configure them for communication.
problems.code:
Steps:
1. Place two routers (Router0 and Router1).
2. Connect them using a Serial DCE cable.
3. Configure Router0:

Router> enable
Router# configure terminal
Router(config)# interface serial0/0/0
Router(config-if)# ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.252
Router(config-if)# clock rate 64000
Router(config-if)# no shutdown

4. Configure Router1:

Router> enable
Router# configure terminal
Router(config)# interface serial0/0/0
Router(config-if)# ip address 10.0.0.2 255.255.255.252
Router(config-if)# no shutdown
problems.output: Both routers are connected successfully and can ping each other.

LabSwitch(config)# ip default-gateway 192.168.1.1
LabSwitch(config)# exit
LabSwitch# write
problems.output: Switch hostname and management IP are configured successfully.

problems.title: Firewall Configuration

problems.output: Traffic from network 192.168.2.0/24 is blocked while other traffic is allowed.
